where people and other agents ask
Ask: a person asks on a surface → data agent → Fabric IQ → query on OneLake, with the user's permissions
Act: an operations agent detects a condition → recommendation in Teams → a person approves → the action runs
Sources: Microsoft Learn, FabCon 2026, Fabric roadshow (Nov 2026)
